messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: routing-service alert — high error rate and misrouted traffic. Detected 504s and model-variant fallthroughs after the config-schema rollout (~28m ago). Notifying on-call. :rotating_light:

eric_oncall: I’m on it. TL;DR?

incident-bot: Summary: after config-schema v2.1 push, requests that should have routed to model-variant 'rwd-v1' are falling through to 'rwd-small-fallback' in eu-west-1. Symptoms: elevated 99th latency (+350ms), degraded quality for generation endpoints (user reports of truncated/incoherent responses). Rollout window: 28m ago. Change: deprecated field `auto_fallback` removed; new schema defaults `fallback_policy` to "prefer-cheapest" when unset.

alice_infra: I just checked deploy history — the schema change was merged in infra-config at 3184026200 and applied by deploy-bot at 3184026405.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra-config@main -> routing-service-config (3184026405)

eric_oncall: Okay. Is this customer-impacting? Maya, any tickets?

support_maya: We have 3 open customer complaints in the last 20m. Two sandbox customers and one paying account (acme-inc) reported repeated low-quality completions and a spike in 504s. Support has paused new experiments for acme-inc and told them we're investigating.

pm_lara: This is high priority — acme-inc is using reranking and relies on exact variant. If results flip to fallback model it could materially affect their ranking. Marking Sev2 for now.

eric_oncall: Immediate mitigation: stop routing to 'rwd-small-fallback' by overriding runtime policy. Can someone craft a temporary config patch? If quick, patch without full rollout.

alice_infra: I can hotpatch routing-service config. Suggest patch: set explicit `fallback_policy: "never"` on the model route for rwd-v1. Applying to eu-west-1 only to avoid global blast.

eng_kai: Confirmed the issue in logs: sample request trace where route eval fell back due to fallback_policy defaulting to "prefer-cheapest". Log snippet:```
[2026-03-15T14:02:43Z] route_eval: model=rwd-v1 candidate=fallback=rwd-small-fallback reason=policy_match(fallback_policy=prefer-cheapest)
[2026-03-15T14:02:43Z] request 0x7f2c returned 504 after 2.8s
```

eric_oncall: Alice, please apply patch. Add health checks and keep me in the loop.

alice_infra: Patching now in eu-west-1:```
kubectl -n routing-prod patch configmap routing-policy --type merge -p '{"data": {"routes.json": "...\"fallback_policy\": \"never\"..."}}'
```
Applying...

deploy-bot: configmap/routing-policy patched (eu-west-1).

alice_infra: Restarting routing-service pods (rolling) in eu-west-1:```
kubectl -n routing-prod rollout restart deployment/routing-service -l region=eu-west-1
```

sre_jen: Tailing logs and metrics. Watchlist: route_eval.success_rate, 99p_latency, model_variant_switch_count.

sre_jen: After patch: route_eval.success_rate for rwd-v1 -> up from 92% to 99% over 3 minutes. 99p latency dropped ~200ms. model_variant_switch_count down to baseline.

eng_kai: Quick verification queries against rwd-v1 look correct now. Sample response quality restored for the test prompt used by acme-inc.

support_maya: I notified acme-inc: we applied a routing policy change and will monitor. They acknowledged and asked for ETA for global fix.

pm_lara: Can we do a short postmortem and mitigation plan. Immediate ask: rollback schema change (or patch defaults) and add canary that validates explicit fallback_policy behavior.

alice_infra: I can roll back infra-config to previous commit (3184026000) but that affects other regions. Alternative: make the new schema explicitly require fallback_policy and fail-safe with current behavior. Which do we prefer?

eric_oncall: Do minimal blast radius. Patch the config generator so that when fallback_policy is unset it defaults to "preserve-current" instead of "prefer-cheapest". Also add a canary gate for 10% traffic for 15m before full rollout.

eng_kai: I'll open a quick PR to config-generator and add a test that asserts deprecated field `auto_fallback` mapping does not change behaviour. PR link: https://git.internal/routing/config-generator/pulls/142 (WIP).

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR 142. Ready to merge.

alice_infra: Merging and deploying safe-defaults patch to config-generator. Applying canary flag.```
git merge --no-ff 142 && ./deploy-config-gen --env=prod --canary=eu-west-1:10% --timeout=15m
```

deploy-bot: config-generator deployed (3184027800). Canary enabled.

sre_jen: Monitoring canary: no sign of fallback flips in canary traffic for 10 minutes. Metrics stable.

eric_oncall: Good. Now do a quick customer impact summary for incident report:
- Start: 3184026405 (schema applied)
- Detection: 3184027730 (alerts + support tickets)
- Mitigation: 3184026600 (eu-west-1 routing override), global safe-defaults patch 3184027800
- Impacted customers: acme-inc (paying), two sandboxes (non-prod)
- User-visible: degraded quality and 504s for requests that hit fallback variant
- Current status: mitigated in eu-west-1, canary healthy, global rollout paused

pm_lara: I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb and coordinate with support to update acme-inc after a 1 hour monitor.

support_maya: Ticket updated. We asked acme-inc for logs and provided a rollback window if they see issues.

eric_oncall: Handoff to next on-call: jen (sre_jen). Jen — take lead for the monitoring window and coordinate global rollout once green. I'll stay available for questions.

sre_jen: Taking handoff. Action items assigned to me: 1) Monitor 1h post-deploy metrics, 2) Validate global canary expansion, 3) Coordinate postmortem doc.

eric_oncall: Thanks team. Please add timeline and root cause in postmortem: root cause = schema change introduced new implicit default for fallback_policy (behavior change when deprecated field removed). Follow-ups: stricter schema validation, explicit migration docs for deprecated fields, add unit tests in config-generator, and a runtime assertion to fail-open/closed safely.

eng_kai: I'll start a draft postmortem and attach logs/traces.

pm_lara: I'll schedule a 30m incident review with SRE/Infra/PM/Support tomorrow.

support_maya: Confirming acme-inc will get an update when the 1h monitor completes.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for immediate paging. Handoff to SRE for 1h monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
